text: Mehr Manzoor Wala-6 Phone: (+92) 51-9252516 Email: info@doam.gov.pk Login Home About Us ( Heritage of Pakistan Publications Projects Advertisements Resources Complaints Trainings Contact Us Mehr Manzoor Wala-6 Type: Archaeological Site - Settlement Province: Punjab District: Layyah Period: Proto Historic Relative Chronology: 3500 BCE - 1800 BCE Description: An archaeological site in ruined condition. Applique pottery of the Hakra phase has been reported during the surface collection. One shard was giving look of Periano reserve pottery, in addition to pottery, a terracotta playing disc was also found during the surface collection.
